messages:
maya: opening a small PR to tidy up streaming/pagination snippets across py/ts/go. goal: show async iterator style, a tiny inline retry helper, and a sync fallback for quickstart. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5010

sam: Will take TS. Plan: swap event-style examples to `for await` and include a 3-line retry helper inline (no deps).

alex: I'll do py. Will include `async` and a blocking example (`stream_sync`) plus a 1-file harness to persist cursors.

jia: Go examples from me: keep recv loop minimal and add a short resume example using ctx + cancel. Avoid external backoff libs.

maya: Also add one-line caveat: pagination tokens are opaque and may be invalidated by model/quantization changes; resumed streams can deliver duplicates so apps should be idempotent.

sam: draft TS snippet:

```ts
// async iterator streaming
const s = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'Summarize' })
for await (const chunk of s) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta ?? '') }

// tiny retry helper (docs only)
async function retry(fn, attempts=3){ for(let i=0;i<attempts;i++){ try{return await fn()}catch(e){ if(i===attempts-1) throw e; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, 200*(2**i))) } } }
```

alex: python draft (compact):

```python
# async stream
async for m in client.chat.stream(model='redwood-1', input='Shorten this'):
    print(m.text)

# blocking variant for quick scripts
for m in client.chat.stream_sync(model='redwood-1', input='Shorten this'):
    print(m.text)
```

jia: go recv loop:

```go
st, err := client.ChatStream(ctx, opts)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
for {
  ch, err := st.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
  fmt.Print(ch.Delta)
}
```

tony: nit: add one-liner showing how to persist token in each language (file write). users copy/paste that.

maya: added small file-persist examples and the opaque-token caveat in the PR description. CI will run snippet-lint.
